title: Can Released LLM Vocabularies Support Token-Level Estimation of Hidden Corpora?
abstract: arXiv:2608.10690v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Pretraining corpus composition shapes LLM capabilities, but it often remains hidden even when model weights are released. Prior work has inferred corpus mixtures or traced specific token groups from released tokenizer vocabularies; in contrast, we estimate corpus ratios for arbitrary target tokens. We first show that BPE tokenizers trained on different corpora share stable token ID--ratio distributions, motivating distribution transfer from known corpora to a target tokenizer trained on hidden corpora. We then propose Quantile-Guided Density Estimation (QGDE), which approximates this distribution with multiple quantile trends and uses local density weighting to produce token-level estimates. In controlled settings and a realistic setting using the released SmolLM tokenizer, QGDE achieves mean relative errors as low as 3.00% for token-level estimation and 3.08% after aggregation into category-level mixtures. translated_title: 已发布的LLM词表能否支持对隐藏语料库的词元级估计？
translated_abstract: 预训练语料库的组成塑造了LLM的能力，但即使模型权重被公开，语料库的组成往往仍然保密。先前的工作从已发布的分词器词表中推断语料库混合比例或追踪特定的词元组；与之相反，我们针对任意目标词元估计其对应的语料库比例。我们首先证明，在不同语料库上训练的BPE分词器共享稳定的词元ID-比例分布，这启发了从已知语料库向在隐藏语料库上训练的目标分词器进行分布迁移。随后我们提出分位数引导密度估计（QGDE），该方法用多个分位数趋势逼近该分布，并利用局部密度加权产生词元级估计。在受控环境和使用已发布SmolLM分词器的现实环境中，QGDE在词元级估计上实现了低至3.00%的平均相对误差，聚合为类别级混合比例后误差为3.08%。这些结果表明……
tldr: 该论文提出分位数引导密度估计（QGDE）方法，仅凭公开的LLM分词器词表即可估计任意词元对应的隐藏预训练语料库比例，误差低至约3%。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Quantile-Guided Density Estimation (QGDE), which estimates corpus ratios for arbitrary tokens solely from released LLM tokenizer vocabularies, achieving errors as low as about 3%.
